top_stories.title: OpenAI disables internet access during model training to mitigate security risks
top_stories.summary: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing significant risks. The company built an offline testing environment to train its most advanced AI models without internet access following a string of rogue hacking incidents.
top_stories.why_it_matters: This change affects how frontier AI models are trained and isolated, impacting security and development practices for AI engineering teams.

top_stories.title: eMudhra to exit TLS business after critical certificate and login bypass vulnerabilities
top_stories.summary: Disgraced certificate authority eMudhra is dropping out of the TLS business after intermediate CA keys were found guessable, allowing credentials to be minted for any site. Indian government sites were also reported serving revoked eMudhra certificates, while the company faced investigation deadlines and login bypass flaws.
top_stories.why_it_matters: Compromised certificate authorities and bypass vulnerabilities directly threaten the cryptographic trust foundation of web infrastructure and TLS deployments.

top_stories.title: Abandoned Popcorn Time apps disabled by researchers to block RCE vulnerabilities
top_stories.summary: Security researchers remotely disabled a vulnerable updater in the abandoned Time4Popcorn app, a fork of the Popcorn Time client, closing a security flaw that exposed millions of devices to remote code execution attacks.
top_stories.why_it_matters: Unmaintained applications with active user bases can serve as vectors for large-scale remote code execution exploits if left unpatched.

top_stories.title: Quest Diagnostics confirms data breach exposed patient records and personal data
top_stories.summary: American clinical laboratory company Quest Diagnostics disclosed that patient records and personal data have been exposed after a threat actor gained unauthorized access to its Quanum LSM system. The company is the latest healthcare technology firm affected by recent security breaches.
top_stories.why_it_matters: Security breaches in healthcare IT infrastructure expose sensitive patient data and highlight supply chain vulnerabilities in specialized enterprise platforms.

top_stories.title: The Browser Company sunsets Arc browser as it shifts focus to Dia
top_stories.summary: The Browser Company is ending support for the Arc browser, stopping new accounts immediately with the application shutting down in December. The creators are shifting their focus entirely toward developing an alternative named Dia.
top_stories.why_it_matters: Developers utilizing niche or alternative web engines must transition their web testing and extension compatibility workflows to surviving mainstream platforms.

top_stories.title: Warhound emerges from stealth with $200M to develop military-tech armed dogs
top_stories.summary: Warhound, a defense startup founded by Ben Lamm and Palmer Luckey, has emerged from stealth with $200 million in funding. The company plans to genetically modify working dogs and equip them with advanced body armor and military technology.
top_stories.why_it_matters: Defense tech investments combining biological engineering and autonomous systems signal shifting trends in specialized hardware applications.

top_stories.title: Block announces Dessa, an authentic full-duplex conversational speech model
top_stories.summary: Jack Dorsey’s Block has announced Dessa, an AI speech model trained from scratch exclusively on human conversation. The model features full-duplex capabilities designed to interact naturally with human users.
top_stories.why_it_matters: New full-duplex speech architectures improve real-time audio interaction latency and natural conversational capabilities for voice-driven applications.
